name: Model Lifecycle, Feature Semantics & Inference Deep Correctness Map

lifecycle_stages.semantics: Synthesizes raw transactional attributes (amounts, categories, countries, devices, velocity, age, scores).
Enforces strict FEATURE_NAMES schema ordering, categorical ordinal mapping via MERCHANT_CATEGORIES, COUNTRIES, DEVICES, and min-max scaling with REFERENCE_BOUNDS.
3-layer MLP (10 -> 64 -> 32 -> 1) with ReLU activations, GroupNorm/BatchNorm1d, Dropout, and final nn.Sigmoid() activation producing probabilities in [0, 1].
Local client optimization with BCELoss (on probabilities), DP noise injection (Opacus), secure/robust aggregation, and state dict serialization.
SR 11-7 lineage tracking, cryptographic sign-off gating, and status assignment (champion/challenger/inactive).

Resolves active champion/global model from registry, dynamically inspects state dict architecture (input_dim, dp_compatible), checks mtime cache invalidation, and fails truthfully if state dict is corrupt.
Validates non-finite (NaN/Inf) inputs, maps categoricals via authoritative vocabulary indices, and normalizes using shared REFERENCE_BOUNDS with bit-level parity to training.
Executes forward pass under torch.no_grad(), validates that output is finite, verifies 0.0 <= prob <= 1.0 (exact single Sigmoid output).
Combines ML prediction with rule-based signals (velocity, reputation, country risk, device anomaly, history) into composite score [0, 1000].
Applies fraud suspicion threshold (score >= 600.0), maps risk levels (LOW/MED/HIGH/CRITICAL), and triggers dynamic policy actions (ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK).
